latin: De subiecto Theologiae fundamentaliter et radicaliter concordant Thommas, Scotus, et Egidius, quamuis in ramis et uerborum superficie quilibet eorum a quolibet dissentire plurimum uideatur.
translation: On the subject of theology, Thomas, Scotus, and Giles are in fundamental and root agreement, although in their branches and in the surface of their words each of them may appear to disagree considerably with the others.
